metaform_schema.description: A functional map records elements and receiver-owned purpose records. This XML illustrates their recursive structure. Record one object per intake tool call. The tool schemas supply the accepted argument names and types.

optional_element_fields.block: The element's established numbered ICE identifier, such as BLOCK_001.
optional_element_fields.within: The namespace address of the element containing this part, when explicitly identified.

rules.rule: The element owning a purpose record is the RE; its nested element is the PE.
PE is not a role. An element may receive in one purpose record and provide in another.
purpose is the only purpose record type.
An annealed part is an element held by a purpose record one level deeper, in the purposes of the PE it is part of; it is not a separate top-level element.
An element is written in full where it first appears; where it appears again it carries namespace_address, name_length, name and role only.
Project elements remain under code, document, media or data regardless of join role.
upstream.* links external code, document, media or data that provide into the project.
downstream.cqu.* links external CQUs; other downstream.* entries link external receivers.
upstream and downstream are project-boundary links, not join-direction namespaces.
Links are not decomposed and hold no project elements beneath them.
An element's refs are items of the sources layer, not fields of the metaform.

Elements and purpose records nest in the same form at every depth. Trace as deep as the artifact's functionality goes; a part stops being traced on its own only where its parent's purpose carries it, never at the depth this template happens to show.
